description: Optional SEC evidence acquisition and folder-grounded agent research continuation with source cutoffs and protected checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: SEC evidence and folder-grounded equities research
interface.longDescription: Use sec-data for source-linked SEC acquisition and finance-research for agent-led continuation in managed version-1 equities folders, preserving reports and edits. Python 3.11+ and the standard library suffice; genuine SEC_USER_AGENT is required only for live SEC acquisition, not local reuse. Judgments are conditional or insufficient when evidence is missing. Source-invoked Codex sessions are observed; installed-plugin loading remains unverified and full investment research remains incomplete. No daemon, trading or global installation.
defaultPrompt: Continue research in my designated managed equities folder at my specified assessment cutoff; discover required work, preserve prior reports and edits, and report evidence gaps and conditional horizon judgments.
